name: Healthy student
label: Safe
interpretation: Standing = Safe (risk score 9.3 / 100).  Your CGPA 3.20 is 1.20 above the 2.0 minimum for BBA / BEE / BS.
advice: You are in good standing. Your CGPA is comfortably above the 2.0 limit.
If you were on probation before, it is cleared and your probation count is reset to zero (5.5.4).

name: Just above the limit after probation
label: Watch
interpretation: Standing = Watch (risk score 26.9 / 100).  Your CGPA 2.20 is 0.20 above the 2.0 minimum for BBA / BEE / BS.
advice: You meet the 2.0 limit, so there is NO probation (5.5.1, 5.5.4).
But the margin is very small. One weak semester could push you below the limit - work on your CGPA now.

name: Second consecutive probation
label: Second-Probation
interpretation: Standing = Second-Probation (risk score 70.0 / 100).  Your CGPA 1.70 is 0.30 below the 2.0 minimum for BBA / BEE / BS.
advice: CGPA is still below the minimum: this is your 2nd CONSECUTIVE probation (5.5.5).
You must NOT register for a new course / semester without the prior approval of the Principal, through your HOD (5.5.5).
If you fail to reach the minimum in the next semester you will be DROPPED (5.5.3).

name: Dropped after two probations
label: Dropped
interpretation: Standing = Dropped (risk score 90.7 / 100).  Your CGPA 1.40 is 0.60 below the 2.0 minimum for BBA / BEE / BS.
advice: You failed to reach the minimum CGPA in the semester after two consecutive probations, so you are DROPPED from the programme (5.5.3).
You may return only as a NEW student after qualifying the entry test, on merit (5.5.6).

name: Summa Cum Laude
label: Summa-Cum-Laude
advice: You qualify for the top honour: SUMMA CUM LAUDE (CGPA 3.90 or above, clause 5.8.1).
Gold / Silver medals (5.7) depend on your rank in the batch, so this tool cannot decide them.
If this is your SEMESTER CGPA, you are on the Rector's Honours List (5.9).

name: Magna Cum Laude
label: Magna-Cum-Laude
advice: You qualify for MAGNA CUM LAUDE honours (CGPA 3.80 to below 3.90, clause 5.8.1).
You are 0.05 CGPA away from Summa Cum Laude.
Gold / Silver medals (5.7) depend on your rank in the batch, so this tool cannot decide them.

name: Near miss (3.55)
label: Near-Miss
advice: Not eligible yet: the minimum is 3.60 (5.6.3) and you are 0.05 short. Honours are decided on the final CGPA at graduation, so there may still be time.
Gold / Silver medals (5.7) depend on your rank in the batch, so this tool cannot decide them.

name: High CGPA but disciplinary penalty
label: Not-Eligible
advice: Baseline condition(s) not met: 5.6.6 (clause 5.6). Under 5.6 you are not eligible for any honour or award, whatever your CGPA.
Gold / Silver medals (5.7) depend on your rank in the batch, so this tool cannot decide them.
If this is your SEMESTER CGPA, you are on the Rector's Honours List (5.9).

name: FAS holder, CGPA 2.55
label: At-Risk
interpretation: Scholarship status = At-Risk (safety score 35.0 / 100).  GPA/CGPA 2.55 is 0.05 above the 2.50 minimum.
advice: You may KEEP the scholarship for now, but you are on the edge.
Scholarship holders are reviewed EVERY semester (4.11, 4.12(d)) - protect your GPA.
Course load is not checked for this need-based scholarship (only merit scholarships need it, 4.4.3.5).

name: Merit scholar, 60% load
label: Suspended
interpretation: Scholarship status = Suspended (safety score 9.3 / 100).  GPA/CGPA 3.90 is 0.15 above the 3.75 minimum.
advice: Merit scholarships require the regular course load of the academic road map, so the scholarship cannot continue (4.4.3.5, 4.12(b)).
It can be restored once the requirement is met again (4.5.3(d), 4.9, 4.11).

name: Advance Merit exactly at 3.50

inputs.category: Advance Merit (Board Topper / Top Ranker / A-Levels)

label: At-Risk
interpretation: Scholarship status = At-Risk (safety score 35.0 / 100).  GPA/CGPA 3.50 is 0.00 above the 3.50 minimum.
advice: You may KEEP the scholarship for now, but you are on the edge.
Scholarship holders are reviewed EVERY semester (4.11, 4.12(d)) - protect your GPA and take the full regular course load (4.4.3.5).

name: FAS holder, CGPA 3.40
label: Secure
interpretation: Scholarship status = Secure (safety score 90.7 / 100).  GPA/CGPA 3.40 is 0.90 above the 2.50 minimum.
advice: Your GPA/CGPA is well above the minimum: the scholarship is SECURE for the coming review (4.5.2).
Course load is not checked for this need-based scholarship (only merit scholarships need it, 4.4.3.5).
